scope: Architecture, authoring, assets, settings UX, schema evolution, and validation for Deep Primal
notes: Primary sources only. Evidence is separated from project proposals. No software dependency, license entitlement, implementation, migration, performance result, or reproducibility result is claimed.

sources.title: Unreal Engine — Data Driven Gameplay Elements
sources.version_scope: Page presented as Unreal Engine 5.8 documentation; a workflow reference, not a project dependency
limits: Does not establish a serialization format for Deep Primal.
Spreadsheet macros and Unreal DataTables are not recommended dependencies.
Engine data-driven authoring does not by itself prove safe live simulation changes.

sources.title: Unreal Engine — Asset Management
sources.version_scope: Page presented as Unreal Engine 5.8 documentation
limits: Unreal-specific identifiers and handles are examples, not a Java API prescription.
The source does not prove that one global manager is the best architecture for this project.
Memory/loading behavior must be measured in Deep Primal.

sources.title: Godot 4.4 — Import process
limits: Godot's exact file layout should not be copied into an existing Deep Primal repository without inspection.
Checksum-based change detection is not a proof of deterministic import.
Source access was via the official indexed manual.

sources.title: Unity 6.2 — Asset metadata
limits: This does not require Unity-style sidecar files; a project manifest may carry equivalent identity.
Renaming a saved gameplay ID requires a migration even if a texture file move is harmless.
The metadata page was read as HTML text.

sources.title: Blender — Geometry Nodes Modifier
sources.version_scope: Retrieved page is labeled Blender 5.2 LTS; no installed tool version is assumed
limits: Official search-index text was inspected; direct manual fetch encountered a tool access error.
This does not guarantee deterministic outputs across Blender versions.
Procedural render meshes must not silently define authoritative voxel geography.

sources.title: Blender — Geometry Nodes Baking
sources.version_scope: Retrieved page is labeled Blender 5.2 LTS
limits: Official indexed text was inspected; direct manual fetch returned a tool access error.
No general claim about other Blender export formats follows from the bake-cache caveat.
No Blender runtime integration is selected.

sources.title: Adobe Substance 3D Designer — Overview
limits: The source does not prescribe pixel-art style, texture sizes, or stone taxonomy; those are project choices.
No Substance runtime licensing or distribution entitlement was evaluated.
Archived helpx pages returned 404; the current official Experience League page was successfully inspected.

sources.title: Godot — EditorInspector
limits: A grouped inspector is not proof of usability; keyboard navigation and task completion need project tests.
Do not expose every engine field as a player setting.
Godot UI classes are references, not dependencies for NeoForge or the standalone frontend.

sources.title: Godot — ConfigFile
limits: ConfigFile is a persistence example, not a recommended Java format or library.
The page does not guarantee atomic writes or crash recovery; those are proposed project requirements.
The required config/deepprimal location comes from project instructions, not Godot's user path.

sources.title: JSON Schema — Draft 2020-12
limits: JSON Schema alone does not prove gameplay validity, cross-file referential integrity, or deterministic results.
No validator library is selected.
Source overview inspected; implementation must select the exact relevant validation specification and vocabulary.

sources.title: FlatBuffers — Schema Evolution
limits: FlatBuffers is not selected as a project serialization dependency.
Its binary evolution rules must not be copied verbatim to unrelated JSON or native host formats.
Syntactic compatibility does not guarantee unchanged gameplay meaning.

sources.title: Reproducible Builds — Definitions
limits: A fixed random seed alone does not establish cross-platform determinism.
This source does not guarantee bit-identical outputs from Blender, Substance, GPU processing, or compression tools.
Select exact reproducibility targets and test the chosen pipeline.
